purpose: Closed public contract for an independently buildable UE5.7 project plugin that normalizes hand and Touch-controller interaction, presence fallback, comfort settings, and MR/VR presentation without receiving or adjudicating Bid Whist state.

TargetHandle.meaning: Opaque local registry handle. It never contains or derives from a card, bid, play, credential, participant identifier, projection, or private string.

TransientOwner.meaning: Read only when HasTransientOwner is true; otherwise the value is the fixed LeftHand default and carries no ownership.

deterministic_interaction_rules: Hands and controllers map into the same semantic_action vocabulary and emit the same closed interaction structure. Semantic parity means identical Action, Phase, TargetHandle and ConfirmGeneration for equivalent input while Source retains the correct hand/controller identity and InteractionId retains one stable interaction identity.
Exactly one input source may own a transient grab or inspection at a time.
A modality change increments TransitionGeneration and emits one local Cancel for every transient owned by the previous modality before accepting a new Begin.

A Confirm is emitted only once for an InteractionId and ConfirmGeneration pair; repeated input edges for that exact pair are local duplicates and do not emit again. TargetHandle is never the idempotency identity.
A lost or unavailable source cancels its transient state and cannot transfer a pending Confirm.
The plugin performs no Bid Whist legality, turn, card, bid, play, score, session, host, queue, standings, replay, persistence, or network authority decision.
Preview, Cancel, and Confirm are semantic local requests only. A later accepted authority adapter owns all authoritative interpretation.
Every nonzero opaque TargetHandle is allocated from a live local registry independent of concealed game values; arbitrary, released, zero when a target is required, or overflowed handles fail closed.
Every externally supplied input phase is rejected unless its source is currently available and belongs to the active modality; internally generated Cancel is the only exception.
Every JSON number is finite, integral, present, correctly typed and inside the exact signed range before conversion. InteractionId is capped at the largest exactly representable JSON integer.
presence_rules: The optional Meta avatar seam is an interface only. This assignment neither installs a Meta SDK nor proves an account, entitlement, avatar asset, or device session.
When the optional adapter is absent, denied, unavailable, or fails, the deterministic fallback is tracked hands or controllers plus nameplate and seat marker.
No stock human avatar, fixed cast, imitation voice, likeness, costume, caricature, or demographic inference is permitted.
The adapter receives only the closed presence view and public tracking poses; it never receives a platform credential, authoritative table object, concealed projection, or private card state.
Platform identifiers and credentials are never serialized, logged, placed in telemetry, copied into nameplates, or exposed through Blueprint.
environment_rules: MixedReality supports bounded table placement, recentering, anchor-loss recovery, and deterministic fallback to VirtualReality when the required capability is unavailable.
VirtualReality provides functionally equivalent table reach, semantic interaction, comfort controls, nameplate, seat marker, and confirmation feedback.
Runtime geometry, materials, icons, sounds, and haptics are original code-native placeholders only.

Environmental warmth and hospitality may be expressed through original lighting, wood, fabric-color, table-spacing, and arrival cues without costumes, stereotypes, fixed human characters, or imitation voices.
Bundled, uploaded, streamed, recorded, rebroadcast, or sampled jazz, blues, voice, image, likeness, or archival content is prohibited.
Host music remains an external, user-controlled facility and is off inside the plugin.
privacy_and_safety_rules: Privacy is enforced by closed types, explicit construction, variant-specific decoding, and byte-level counterfactual tests only.

Regex, blacklist, keyword, substring, redaction, scanning, best-effort filtering, inference, and concealed-object-then-delete designs are prohibited as privacy, disclosure, authorization, logging, or provider-routing controls.
The plugin has no network, credential, filesystem-upload, microphone, recording, music-stream, moderation, purchase, account, license-acceptance, store, or deployment authority.

NullRHI and Win64 automation cannot prove Android packaging, Quest performance, hand tracking, controller tracking, passthrough, anchors, Meta presence, multiplayer, accessibility comfort, human acceptance, cultural acceptance, rights clearance, or store readiness.

integration_boundary.current_assignment: The plugin is independently buildable and testable and exports only its closed public types, subsystem, capability seams, and semantic-event delegate.
integration_boundary.later_assignment: After Claude and robot-dealer candidates are independently accepted, a separate Cursor integration packet may bind this plugin's semantic delegate to accepted authority and public cue interfaces from Cursor-owned paths.
integration_boundary.acceptance_limit: OpenAI may accept the isolated plugin as its own candidate but cannot call the combined game, physical Quest experience, or three-stage product complete before integration and all later gates pass.
